verify_reason: Third-party submission — submitter is not owner, collaborator, or contributor
risk_summary: openclaw-sec is a substantive security detection library whose high-severity SAST findings are overwhelmingly false positives arising from scanner context collapse — the tool's own detection patterns and test fixtures are being flagged as live credentials and malicious code. The primary residual risk is the unaudited hook installation mechanism (user-prompt-submit-hook.ts, tool-call-hook.ts, install-hooks.sh), which installs persistent hooks intercepting all agent interactions and whose source code is not present in the scan evidence. A 47-day-old account publishing a security tool with persistent hook capabilities warrants conditional approval pending hook code review.
